topic: Signing Up for the School Bus Route Stop

script.title: SCHOOL BUS ROUTE
script.scene_zh: 交通辦公室 · 登記校車路線
script.story_hook: A dad, a bus route, and a very early morning.
script.intro_zh: 一位爸爸、一條校車路線，和一個非常清晨的早晨。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the bus office today. Listen for route and timing words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的交通辦公室。留意路線與時間的說法。
script.outro: And that's a bus route all sorted. Listen again and say it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一條校車路線就這樣安排妥當。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Mornings are chaos at my house
script.char_a_description: a tired father in his late thirties with curly dark brown hair, a short stubble beard, a green field jacket over a striped sweater, brown boots, and a broad build
script.char_b_description: a no-nonsense bus office clerk in her fifties with a chin-length grey bob, rectangular glasses, a tan blazer over a white blouse, a lanyard badge, and a sturdy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to sign my son for the bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə saɪn maɪ ˈsʌn fɚ ðə ˈbʌs/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想幫我家男孩報名坐校車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, which school will he be riding to?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wɪtʃ skul wil hɪ bə ˈɹaɪdɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，他要去哪一所學校？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lincoln Elementary, he's in third grade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪŋkən ˌɛləˈmɛntəɹi hɪz ɪn θɝd ɡɹeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 林肯小學，他讀三年級。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, third grade uses route twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ θɝd ɡɹeɪd juz ɹut twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 好，三年級坐十二號線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Route twelve. Does that stop near our street?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹut twɛlv dʌz ðæt stɑp nɪɹ ˈaʊɚ stɹit/
dialogue.zh: 十二號線。它會在我們家附近停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stops on Cedar and Fifth, one corner away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑps ɑn ˈsidɚ ænd fɪfθ wʌn ˈkɔɹnɚ əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 停在雪鬆街和第五街，隔一個街口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's about a five minute walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðæts əˈbaʊt ə faɪv ˈmɪnət wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那大概走路五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little more, seven minutes from your block.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪɾəl mɔɹ ˈsɛvən ˈmɪnəts fɹʌm jɔɹ blɑk/
dialogue.zh: 還多一點，從你家那條街要走七分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, is that too far for a nine year old?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪz ðæt tu fɑɹ fɚ ə ˈnaɪn jɪɹ ˈoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 噢，對九歲的孩子來說會不會太遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine is fine on our list, he can ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪn ɪz faɪn ɑn ɑɹ lɪst hi kən ˈɹaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 九歲符合規定，他可以搭乘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. What time does the bus come by?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wʌt ˈtaɪm dʌz ðə ˈbʌs kʌm ˈbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。校車幾點會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven ten, so he should be waiting early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən tɛn soʊ hi ʃʊd bi ˈweɾɪŋ ˈɝli/
dialogue.zh: 七點十分，所以他最好早一點在那裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven ten, um, that's pretty early for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən tɛn ʌm ðæts ˈpɹɪti ˈɝli fɚ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 七點十分，嗯，對我們來說有點早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me about it, mine are worse.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt maɪn ɑɹ wɝs/
dialogue.zh: 我也懂，我家的情況更糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, mornings are chaos at my house too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ɑɹ ˈkeɪˌɑs æt maɪ haʊs tu/
dialogue.zh: 哈，早上的我家也是一片混亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, is there an adult who walks him over?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪz ðɛɹ ən əˈdʌlt hu wɔks hɪm ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 所以，有大人陪他走到路口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Usually me, but sometimes my wife can't.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəli mi bʌt ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz maɪ waɪf kænt/
dialogue.zh: 通常是我，但有時候我太太不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine, we don't require a name each day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn wi doʊnt ɹɪˈkwaɪɚ ə neɪm itʃ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我們不要求每天都是同一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good. Is there a backup if he misses it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈbækˌʌp ɪf hi ˈmɪsɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢好。如果他錯過了，有備用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we keep a late list for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi kip ə ˈleɪt ˈlɪst fɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 有，我們為那種情況保留一份晚名單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A late list? How does that work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈleɪt ˈlɪst haʊ dʌz ðæt ˈwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 晚名單？那是怎麼運作的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waits at school, we bus them at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi weɪts æt ˈskul wi bʌs ðɛm æt ˈeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他在學校等，我們八點再送一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight, got it. Do I sign up for that too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪt ˌɡɑɾ ˈɪt du aɪ ˈsaɪn ʌp fɚ ðæt ˈtu/
dialogue.zh: 八點，記下了。那個我也要另外報名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tick a box here, one for mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tɪk ə bɑks hɪɹ wʌn fɚ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡勾一個格子就好，早上那項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And after school, is he on the regular run?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈæftɚ skul ɪz hi ɑn ðə ˈɛɡjəlɚ ɹʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那放學後，他坐的是同一班車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same route, but he gets dropped after three.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ɹut bʌt hi ɡɛts ˈdɹɑpt ˈæftɚ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 同一路線，但他三點後才坐車回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three fifteen, or three sharp?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi ˈfɪftɪn ɔɹ θɹi ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 三點十五，還是三點整？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three fifteen, it shifts with traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi ˈfɪftɪn ɪt ʃɪfts wɪð ˈtɹæfɪk/
dialogue.zh: 三點十五，會依交通情況變動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Can he ride home to grandma's instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kən hi ɹaɪd hoʊm tə ˈɡɹæməz ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 好。他可以改去奶奶家下車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with a note, and only two days a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɪð ə noʊt ænd ˈoʊnli tu deɪz ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 要有紙條才行，而且一週只有兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Who do I call if the bus runs late?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ hu du aɪ ˈkɔl ɪf ðə ˈbʌs ɹʌnz ˈleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 合理。如果校車晚點我該打給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a number on the sticker by his seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə ˈnʌmbɚ ɑn ðə ˈstɪkɚ baɪ hɪz sit/
dialogue.zh: 座位旁邊的貼紙上有一個電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sticker, good, he won't lose that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstɪkɚ ɡʊd hi woʊnt luz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 貼紙，很好，他不會弄丟那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hope not. Now, does he have any allergies?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊp nɑt naʊ dʌz hi hæv ˈɛni ˈælɝdʒiz/
dialogue.zh: 希望不會。對了，他有沒有過敏？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None on the bus, but he carries an EpiPen.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ɑn ðə bʌs bʌt hi ˈkæɹiz ən ˈɛpəˌpɛn/
dialogue.zh: 校車上沒有過敏，但他隨身帶一支腎上腺素注射筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I'll flag his rider file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt aɪl flæɡ hɪz ˈɹaɪdɚ faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我會在他的搭乘檔案上做記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Does the bus have a seat belt?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju dʌz ðə ˈbʌs hæv ə ˈsɪt ˈbɛlt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。校車上有安全帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours are older, no belts, but padded seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚz ɑɹ ˈoʊldɚ noʊ bɛlts bʌt ˈpædɪd sits/
dialogue.zh: 我們的車比較舊，沒有安全帶，但座位有軟墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's a small worry for me, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðæts ə smɔl ˈwɝi fɚ mi ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，說實話這讓我有點擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get it, mine too. He'll ride in front.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt maɪ ˈtu hil ˈɹaɪd ɪn ˈfɹʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，我也一樣。他會坐前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps. What about snow days?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps wʌt əˈbaʊt snoʊ deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這有幫助。那下雪天怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We text the whole route, so keep your number current.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɛkst ðə hoʊl ɹut soʊ kip jɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚ ˈkɝənt/
dialogue.zh: 我們會簡訊通知整條線的家長，所以號碼要保持最新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my number hasn't changed since last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ hæzənt tʃeɪndʒd sɪns læst jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我的電話從去年到現在都沒變。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we're set. Here's his bus pass card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɪɹ ˈsɛt hɪɹz hɪz ˈbʌs ˌpæs ˈkɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 那我們都弄好了。這是他的乘車證卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bus pass? He just shows this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbʌs ˌpæs hi ˈdʒʌst ʃoʊz ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 乘車證？他只要出示這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To the driver each morning, that's it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə ðə ˈdɹaɪvɚ itʃ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ðæts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 每天早上給司機看就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple. Do I pay anything for the route?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl du aɪ peɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ fɚ ðə ɹut/
dialogue.zh: 簡單。這條路線要付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rides are free, only the late bus is ten dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪdz ɑɹ fɹi ˈoʊnli ðə leɪt bʌs ɪz tɛn ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 搭車免費，只有補送那班要十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten for the late one, okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn fɚ ðə leɪt wʌn oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 補送那班十塊，好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pay online or bring cash to school.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs peɪ ˌɑnˈlaɪn ɔɹ brɪŋ kæʃ tə skul/
dialogue.zh: 對，線上付或帶現金去學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll pay online tonight, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl peɪ ˌɑnˈlaɪn təˈnaɪt θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就線上付，真的謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Any other questions?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈwɛlkəm ˈɛni ˈʌðɚ ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。還有別的問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, can a sibling ride the same route?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kən ə ˈsɪblɪŋ ɹaɪd ðə seɪm ɹut/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，兄弟姐妹可以坐同一班車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, add his sister on the same stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æd hɪz ˈsɪstɚ ɑn ðə seɪm stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把他妹妹加在同一個站上車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's in first grade, will that be okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiɹz ɪn fɝst ɡɹeɪd wɪl ðæt bi oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 她上一年級，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First grade is route eight, a different bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst ɡɹeɪd ɪz ɹut eɪt ə ˈdɪfɹənt bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 一年級是八號線，是另一輛車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, then she'd walk to a different corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛn ʃi d wɔk tə ə ˈdɪfɹənt ˈkɔɹnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那她要走到不一樣的路口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small trade off, but yes, two stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmɔl ˈtɹeɪd ˌɔf bʌt jɛs tu ˈstɑps/
dialogue.zh: 是個小妥協，是的，兩個站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can manage that, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən ˈmænɪdʒ ðæt aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我們應付得來，我想沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, see you on the first bus day!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹeɪt si ju ɑn ðə fɝst ˈbʌs ˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，第一次坐車那天見！

script.youtube_title_en: "Mornings Are Chaos at My House" — Signing Up for the School Bus
script.youtube_description:
「早上我家總是一片混亂」——開學前，怎麼幫孩子登記學校巴士的路線與站牌？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在交通辦公室的櫃台前。

你會聽到：確認幾年級坐幾號線、查停靠點離家多遠、走路幾分鐘；早上幾點上車、錯過了怎麼辦、晚名單怎麼運作；還有能不能改去奶奶家、安全帶與下雪天通知、兄弟姐妹不同路線。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與日常短句，反覆出現的是美國家長真實的語感：um、so、oh、ha、got it。聽完你就會用：I'd like to sign、Does that stop、How does that work、What about。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Mornings are chaos at my house" — how do you sign your kid up for the school bus route and stop before the first day? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at the transport office counter.

You will hear: matching a grade to a route number, checking how far the stop is and the walk time, the early pickup time, what happens if he misses it and how the late list works, riding to grandma's, seat belts, snow-day alerts, and siblings on different routes.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk parents really use: um, so, oh, ha, got it. By the end you'll own phrases like I'd like to sign, Does that stop, and How does that work.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
開學前要幫孩子申請校車，幾年級坐哪條線？站牌離家要走幾分鐘？早上遲到了怎麼辦？兄弟姐妹是不是搭同一班車？

這一集帶大家走進學校交通辦公室，從登記路線、確認上車點、晚名單運作，一路聽到改送奶奶家、安全帶、下雪天通知與兄弟姐妹不同路線，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🚌 分線句：Okay, third grade uses route twelve.
🚏 站點句：Route twelve. Does that stop near our street?
⏰ 備用句：Yes, we keep a late list for that.
🧒 手足句：add his sister on the same stop.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，讓 um、oh、got it 這些語感自然長在嘴邊。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這位爸爸在櫃台前一問一答，下次自己替孩子報路線，話就從嘴邊自己冒出來。

祝你家孩子開學坐車一切順利。
